question: What is printed? Explain, pass by pass, what happens to i.
answer: i starts at 1. 1 < 5 is true, the body i++ makes i 2, the update makes it 3. 3 < 5 is true, the body makes it 4, the update makes it 5. 5 < 5 is false, so the loop stops. Only i++ was in the loop. Then the two println lines print 5 and 5.
